name: Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury of the Elbow
tags: ulnar collateral ligament injury of the elbow
definition: Injury of the medial ulnar collateral ligament of the elbow, common in throwing athletes exposed to repetitive valgus stress.

investigations.principle: MRI/MR arthrography can define ligament injury; radiographs assess avulsion/valgus extension overload.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: High-grade tears in competitive throwers may require reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the medial ulnar collateral ligament of the elbow, common in throwing athletes exposed to repetitive valgus stress.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
